description: One node of an agent run: an agent, a delegated sub-agent, a tool call or a step, its live state and the numbers the run is watched by. The list a host passes to TmAgentRunTree is FLAT and the tree comes from ParentId: a node whose parent names no supplied node is an orphan attached under the root, and a parent cycle is rejected and reported. The record is a VALUE; Timestamps are the only source of a duration.
